author: Kurz & Allison

locator: panel 14 (Sauganash Hotel); panel 11 (Green Tree); panel 5 (Fort Dearborn as rebuilt 1835); panel 9 (Wolf Point in 1830); panel 12 (Kinzie Mansion)
note: Fifteen retrospective vignettes of early Chicago with a printed key giving names, build dates and populations. Panel 14, 'The Sauganash Hotel. Built in 1831', shows a two-story clapboard block with an attached single-story log wing and NO full-width gallery — the composition follows the F. Braunhold engraving in Andreas (1884) closely enough that it is probably derived from it rather than an independent witness. Panel 5, 'Fort Dearborn as rebuilt 1835', is the most directly scene-relevant image in the sheet: picket palisade, a galleried barracks range, a blockhouse. Its own dating is unreliable — it puts the Kinzie Mansion at 1832, contradicting every documentary source.
